guided.text: 👋 These are your cards — your hand. You’ll play them onto the field to fight.
▶️ Your turn: drag a card from your hand onto the field (or tap it, then tap a side). One card per turn.
🏰 This is the enemy Castle. Bring its health to 0 to win the fight.
⚔️ Each round, every card attacks the card across from it. If nothing stands across, it hits the Castle instead.
🃏 This is your Deck. At the start of every turn you draw one card from it into your hand.
🪙 This gold coin is initiative. When two cards face each other evenly, the side holding the coin strikes first. It changes sides every round.

passive.text: ⏳ This number is the card's Wait: how many rounds it must spend on the field before it can attack.
Their castle has a passive of its own.
👑 Your Leader: drag it onto the field to summon it, once per match. Summoning uses your play for the turn.
✋ You can hold 5 cards. Draw past that and the extra card is discarded for +1 Lumber automatically.
⚡ This badge is a trigger: an effect the card fires by itself. Greyed out means it is off for now: triggers that fire every round or when hit stay off while the
⚡ Lit up means ready: once its Wait runs out the trigger switches on and fires every time its moment comes. “When played” and “When it dies” triggers work even
✨ Poison: Its hits add 1 Poison.
✨ Decay: Its hits add 1 Decay.
✨ Armor: Takes 1 less damage from every hit.
✨ Counterattack: Never attacks on its own. Strikes back at whoever hits it.
✨ Spiteful: Deal 1 damage back to any enemy that damages it.
✨ Thorns: Melee attackers take 1 damage.
✨ Fork: Hits the two columns beside the one in front instead.
✨ Swipe: Each hit steals 1 Lumber.
✨ Twin Strike: Attacks twice.
✨ Converge: When it becomes ready, the enemy’s board closes its gaps: units pack together around the centre, in the same order.
✨ Defiance: +1 Attack for every enemy unit that is (pick a type).
✨ Pack: Arrives with +1 Health for each ally that shares a type with it.
✨ Cleave: Also deals 1 damage to the units beside its target.
✨ Rage: Below half Health: double Attack and takes half damage.
✨ Immolation: Deal 1 fire damage to all adjacent units every upkeep.
✨ Swarm: +1 Attack for every ally that shares a type with it (e.g. every other Ant beside an Ant).
✨ Hive Mind: When it dies, your newest Swarm ally gets +1/+1.
✨ Crepuscular: At Twilight: gain +1/+0. (A deck with one turns the day into Day, Night, Day, Night, Twilight.)
✨ Sun-shy: Blind by day: misses 1 attack in 2 while the sun is up.
✨ Night-blind: Blind at night: misses 1 attack in 2 after dark (a Lantern on your side lights it).
✨ Nocturnal: At night: gain +1/+0.
✨ Diurnal: By day: gain +1/+0.
✨ Reach: Flying can't dodge its attacks.
✨ Festering: While it's on the field, Bleed and Poison don't wear off.
✨ Dictator: Can only be your Leader. It never goes in your deck.
✨ Changeling: Shares a type with every unit. The enemy sees it in disguise.
✨ Drunk: Always Tipsy.
✨ Purblind: Always Blind.
✨ Scatterbrained: Always Confused.
✨ Primed: Its triggers work even while Waiting, Stunned, Frozen or Asleep.
✨ Keen Eye: Sees through Changelings and hits them for 2 more.
✨ Demolisher: Deals 1 more damage to Structures.
✨ Lantern: At night, your Diurnal units keep their day bonus.
✨ Backstab: Attacks the nearest enemy unit, never the castle. +1 damage when that unit isn't the one in front.
✨ Shield Call: Once a battle, the first enemy skill aimed at one of your units hits a 0/10 Guardian shield instead.
✨ Boomerang: Its throw comes back next round and hits the same target again. Catch it!
✨ Trident: Hits the unit in front and both columns beside it with full Attack.
✨ Pitchfork: Hits the unit in front and both columns beside it with full Attack, ignoring Armor.
✨ Octolash: Hits the 8 nearest enemy units with full Attack.
✨ Rainmaker: When played, Spring Rain falls for 1 rounds.
✨ Rainrunner: In rain: +1/+1, and it can't be blocked.
✨ Moonborn: At night: up to +1/+1, depending on the moon's phase.
✨ Frostbite: Each time frost chills it, it gains +1/+1 for good.
✨ Swimmer: On Flow: +1 Attack.
✨ Swimmer: on Flow: On a Flow round it gains 1.
✨ Inspiring: When it attacks, adjacent allies get +1 Attack on their next attack.
✨ Friction: When it attacks, deal 1 damage to adjacent allies.
✨ Worthy: When played, gain 1 Lumber. When it dies, the opponent gains 1 Lumber.
✨ Lumberjack: Whenever you gain Lumber, gain 1 more.
✨ Heavy Metal: Whenever you gain Stone or Metal, gain 1 more.
✨ Timber: +1/+1 for each Lumber you hold.
✨ Rock-solid: +2/+2 for each Stone you hold.
✨ Iron-will: +3/+3 for each Metal you hold.
✨ Loyal: While one of your leaders is on the battlefield: +1/+0.
✨ Usurper: While the opposing leader is on the battlefield: +1/+0.
✨ Sacrifice: A Dark Summon played onto it costs 1 less, and this unit perishes.
✨ Scare: Attacks against it deal 1 less damage.
✨ Prayer: Adds 1 to your Prayer while it's on your board.
✨ Worship: +1 Attack for every 3 Prayer you have.
✨ Healing: Heal your most wounded unit for 1 every upkeep.
✨ Shedding: Every 1 rounds on the field it sheds its skin: +1/+1 for good, and Poison, Bleed, Corrosion, Scar and Expose come off with it.
✨ Bludgeon: Each hit knocks out one of the target's defences.
✨ Snipe: Every round while Ready, if nothing stands opposite it: shoots a random enemy unit for 1.
✨ Kinship: All your <Type> units get +0/+0 (itself too, if it is one). Stacks.
✨ Rocket: Once, when it's Ready (on arrival if it has no Wait): a rocket hits the strongest enemy unit (highest Attack) for 1 Heat damage and 1 to each enemy be
✨ Lone Wolf: Likes room: +1/+0 for each empty slot within 2 of it (4 in all), and +1/+0 more when all 4 are empty.
✨ Sociable: Likes a crowd: +1/+0 for each ally within 2 slots of it (up to 4), and +1/+0 more with all 4 filled.
✨ Coffee: Comes in wired: Wait −1. 1 round later the cup wears off and it naps (Stunned for a round).
✨ Dry: Built for the desert: takes half Heat damage, and Scorching days can't touch it.
✨ Darksight: Sees in complete darkness: in caves and the deep, everyone else without a Lantern swings blind (misses 1 in 2).
✨ Landslide: When it falls: rocks crash on the enemy facing it and the enemy on each side of that one, 1 damage each. Flying units are above it.
✨ Nature's Force: All your Elementals on the field get +1/+1. Stacks with every other source.
✨ Lightning: When played, deal 1 damage to a random enemy unit, +1 for every 4 Prayer.
✨ Midas Touch: When it kills a unit, gain 1 Lumber.
✨ Divine Retribution: When one of your units dies, deal 1 damage to a random enemy unit.
✨ Satiety: At full Health, gains +1 max Health every upkeep.
✨ Desecrate: Its hits curse the ground: whoever stands there takes 1 damage every upkeep. Stacks.
✨ Tide: Flow: +1 Attack. Ebb: +1 Armor.
✨ Remember: In your Removal Zone: at upkeep, spend 1 Echoes to return with +1/+1.
✨ Wash: On Flow, the enemy facing it gets +1 Wait (once per enemy).
✨ Expose: Its hits mark the target: +1 damage on the next hit it takes.
✨ Guardian: Takes the hits aimed at adjacent allies.
✨ Quick: Attacks before every unit without Quick.
✨ Fast Forward: Takes 1 extra turn when it arrives.
✨ Swift: Always attacks first, and dodges attacks from units without Swift.
✨ Reload: After attacking, sits out 1 round.
✨ Shell: When first hit: +1 Armor and +1 Health until the end of next round, but it can't attack that round.
✨ Stealth: Always attacks the enemy castle.
✨ Evasive: Dodges half of all single-target attacks and skills.
✨ Feeble: Deals half damage.
✨ Mighty: Deals double damage.
✨ Fragile: Takes double damage.
✨ Sturdy: Takes half damage.
✨ Crit: Each round, a 1-in-2 chance to deal double damage.
✨ Fester: Deals extra damage equal to its own Poison.
✨ Rupture: Deals extra damage equal to its own Bleed.
✨ Bleed: Its hits add 1 Bleed.
✨ Esprit: Gains +1/+0 whenever another ally enters play.
✨ Regeneration: Heals 1 every upkeep.
✨ Stun: Its hits have a 1% chance to Stun.
✨ Puncture: Each melee hit also deals 1 damage to the enemy castle.
✨ Gash: When played, add 1 Bleed to the enemy facing it.
✨ Stampede: Damage left over from a kill carries on into the enemy castle.
✨ Berserk: +1 Attack whenever one of your units dies.
✨ Bulwark: Your castle takes 1 less damage from every hit.
✨ Reflect: 1% chance to throw a melee hit's full damage back at the attacker.
✨ Momentum: +1 Attack every time it kills a unit.
✨ Bloom: Heal a random wounded ally for 1 every upkeep.
✨ Ambush: Its first attack always crits and can't be dodged.
✨ Siege: Deals 1 more damage to the enemy castle.
✨ Corrode: Its hits add 1 Corrode.
✨ Daunt: Its hits lower the target's Attack by 1 until the end of next round. Stacks.
✨ Recoil: Each attack also deals 1 damage to itself.
✨ Inherent Darkness: While Ready, gain 1 Darkness every upkeep.
✨ Core Evil: When pitched, gain 1 Darkness.
✨ Frenzy: While it has any status, it attacks twice and each hit adds 1 Bleed.
✨ Pierce: Its melee hits ignore 1 Armor.
✨ Perforate: Its melee hits ignore and strip 1 Armor, add 1 Bleed and deal 1 damage to the enemy castle.
✨ Flying: Dodges half of all attacks from units without Flying.
✨ Earthquake: When played, deal 1 damage to every other unit without Flying, yours included.
✨ Pounce: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy unit, or the castle if there are no targets.
✨ Skyfall: When played, deal 1 damage to a random enemy unit, or the castle if there are no targets.
✨ Arrow: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it for 1 damage every upkeep.
✨ Fire Arrow: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it for 1 fire damage every upkeep.
✨ King Slayer: Deals 1 more damage to Kings.
✨ Explode: A lit fuse, ticking every round regardless of Wait/Stun. At 0, deals Damage to whatever is opposite (or the HQ if empty), once.
✨ Freeze: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Freeze the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Sleep: Every landed attack has a Chance% to put the target to Sleep for Duration round(s).
✨ Paralyze: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Paralyze the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Blind: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Blind the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Make Tipsy: Every landed attack has a Chance% to make the target Tipsy for Duration round(s).
✨ Confuse: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Confuse the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Shock: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Shock the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Stagger: Every landed attack has a Chance% to Stagger the target for Duration round(s).
✨ Chained: Chained: cannot attack (gatherAttackers skips it, same as Frozen/Asleep/Stunned) until its chain breaks — either from taking more than N damage in on
✨ Render: On Spawn: lowers the opposing creature's Attack by 1.
✨ Revivificated: The first time it dies, it comes back with 1 Health and its statuses cleared. This only happens once.
✨ Progeny: Bundled trigger + action shorthand: this card's own death spawns 1× (pick a card) onto its row.
☠️ Poisoned: this card takes damage equal to its poison stacks at the start of every round.
🩸 Bleeding: this card takes damage every time it attacks, defends or uses a skill.
❄️ Frozen: this card can’t act and its Wait doesn’t tick down until it thaws.
💤 Asleep: can’t act until it wakes — any damage wakes it.
⚡ Paralyzed: each round there’s a 1-in-2 chance it can’t act.
💫 Stunned: skips its attack this round.
🍺 Tipsy: this card swings left, ahead or right at random, and misses if nobody is there.
❓ Confused: half the time, this card's triggers and on-hit skills fizzle.
👁 Blind: this card's swings miss half the time.
⛓️ Chained: can’t attack until its chain breaks.
😨 Daunted: this card has less Attack until the end of next round. More hits, more Attack lost.
